description: Defines synchronization primitives and stop event mechanisms using futexes and busy waiting policies, including classes for stop event source and tokens with thread-safe stop signaling.

classes.name: futex_blocker
classes.description: Blocking policy based on Linux futexes for thread synchronization.

classes.name: busy_wait_blocker
classes.description: Blocking policy based on busy waiting with sleep intervals.

classes.name: stop_event_source_impl
classes.description: Template class managing stop signals and observer tokens with thread safety.

classes.name: stop_event_token_impl
classes.description: Template class representing an observer token for stop events, managing lifecycle and stop request status.

methods.name: get_token
methods.description: Creates a new observer token for stop events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Requests all tokens to stop and waits until all are reset.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stop request state, blocking if a stop is ongoing.

methods.name: was_stop_requested
methods.description: Checks if a stop has been requested.

methods.name: is_stop_requested
methods.description: Checks if the associated stop event has been signaled.
